prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, channels, and whether you want a full-service partner or a niche specialist. I can help you find the best match. To start:

Quick questions
- What are your primary goals? (e.g., lead generation, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, SEO, social advertising)
- What’s your monthly or project budget range?
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, paid search/ social, content, email, web design, CRO)
- Do you need industry experience (B2B, healthcare, finance, retail, hospitality)?
- Do you prefer an in‑house local agency vs. a remote/ national firm?

How to evaluate agencies (checklist)
- Case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, conversion rate, ROI)
- Relevant industry experience and client references
- Client retention and team stability
- Transparency in pricing and reporting cadence
- Specifics of proposed strategy (not just buzzwords)
- Ability to integrate with your tech stack (CRM, analytics)
- Communication style, frequency, and point of contact

Where to look for top St. Louis agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity (ratings + client reviews)
- Google My Business / Google Maps reviews
- LinkedIn (company pages + employee expertise)
- Local business press (St. Louis Business Journal) and award lists
- Personal referrals from local businesses in your industry

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- What results have you delivered for clients like us? Can you share metrics?
- Who will be our day‑to‑day contact and who does the work?
- What will you prioritize in the first 90 days?
- How do you measure ROI and report results?
- What is your pricing model and contract length?
- Can you share references we can call?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a short list of well‑matched St. Louis agencies if you tell me the answers to the questions above, or
- Draft a short RFP or outreach email you can send to agencies, or
- Explain how to compare proposals you receive.

Which of the options above would you like me to do next?
